description: This file defines various classes related to rendering information for charts in the PDFsharp library, including base classes, specific renderer info for chart components, axes, data points, labels, and legends.

classes.name: RendererInfo
classes.description: Base class for all renderer information classes.

classes.name: AreaRendererInfo
classes.description: Base class for renderer info that defines an area, with properties for position and size.

classes.name: ChartRendererInfo
classes.description: Stores main parts of a chart, including axes, plot area, legend, and series info.

classes.name: CombinationRendererInfo
classes.description: Stores info for rendering combined charts with multiple series types.

classes.name: PointRendererInfo
classes.description: Represents a single data point in a series, with methods to check initialization.

classes.name: SectorRendererInfo
classes.description: Represents a pie chart sector, inheriting from PointRendererInfo.

classes.name: ColumnRendererInfo
classes.description: Represents a data point with an associated rectangle, inheriting from PointRendererInfo.

classes.name: DataLabelEntryRendererInfo
classes.description: Contains rendering info for a data label entry.

classes.name: DataLabelRendererInfo
classes.description: Contains rendering info for data labels, including format, font, and position.

classes.name: SeriesRendererInfo
classes.description: Holds rendering info for a data series, including points, labels, and styles.

classes.name: MarkerRendererInfo
classes.description: Describes marker style for line charts.

classes.name: AxisRendererInfo
classes.description: Contains axis-specific rendering info, including scale, tick marks, gridlines, and labels.

classes.name: AxisTitleRendererInfo
classes.description: Stores info for axis titles, including text, font, and orientation.

classes.name: LegendEntryRendererInfo
classes.description: Represents a legend entry with marker and text sizes.

classes.name: LegendRendererInfo
classes.description: Stores legend rendering info, including entries.

classes.name: PlotAreaRendererInfo
classes.description: Contains info for rendering the plot area, including transformation matrix.

methods.name: DefaultFont
methods.description: Gets the default font for chart rendering.

methods.name: DefaultDataLabelFont
methods.description: Gets the default font for data labels.

methods.name: Check
methods.description: Validates that the PointRendererInfo is properly initialized.

methods.name: base.Check
methods.description: Calls the base class check method for PointRendererInfo.
